name: Cortex
label: Cortex analyzers/responders API (customer-hosted)
description: Official Cortex REST (Cortex 2+) via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://docs.strangebee.com/cortex/api/api-guide/. Auth header Authorization with empty prefix (raw API key). Submitting observables may share IOCs/file bytes with third-party scanners configured on that Cortex. cortexHost is host[:port] without scheme (default listen 9001). File observables need multipart; OfficialApiNode sends JSON.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path/query/body keys match api_spec.json.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: execute-analyzer | get-job | get-job-report | execute-responder.

schema.label: analyzerId
schema.description: Enabled analyzer instance id for execute-analyzer.

schema.label: responderId
schema.description: Enabled responder instance id for execute-responder.

schema.label: dataType
schema.description: Observable type (ip, domain, hash, file, …) or responder datatype.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Observable value or responder JSON. Do not log IOCs.

schema.label: message
schema.description: Request-body parameter `message` for operations: execute-analyzer, execute-responder.

schema.label: parameters
schema.description: Request-body parameter `parameters` for operations: execute-analyzer, execute-responder.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default verb when input.operation is blank.

configurationParameters.label: Cortex host
configurationParameters.description: Cortex host without scheme. Example: cortex.example.com:9001. OfficialApiNode URL-encodes path placeholders.

configurationParameters.label: API key
configurationParameters.description: Cortex API key. Header Authorization with empty prefix (raw key). StudioQuack secret. Never on INPUT or in logs.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Analyzer jobs can be slow. Default 60.
